display_name: Phase1 fixed source candidate reliability feature extraction
description: Extract classifier confidence, relative embedding and waveform distances for five fixed restoration candidates on the 1047 source L_s records, without source labels.
authorization: 用户要求大胆研发 Phase1 恢复网络，不拘泥 DURA，地面基座 Tri-SIG-TIME SSL；不使用 Phase3。

code.environment: N607 GPU0 fixed source inference and two CPU threads, TF32 disabled

data.version: original7/63/30 Phase1 source physical ID contract
data.representation: Source IQ [2,256], 5 fixed candidate waveforms, frozen F confidence and label-invariant pairwise features
data.label_map_ref: Frozen Tri-SIG-TIME SSL source contract, six classes
data.tx_sets_ref: Only legitimate source L_s truth after all predictions fixed; no U_s truth, V or test read
data.validation_ref: All L_s RX4/6 source validation and RX8 source holdout day3, physical IDs previously observed

permissions.query_use: Source IQ and fixed candidate predictions only; no source true labels, U_s truth, V or target data during extraction
permissions.claim_scope: Source L_s data previously used by ground F and/or prior views; not independent blind or target test

checkpoint.initialization: Frozen DURA comparator, six-component and twelve-component blind priors, joint and free source controllers, frozen F and gate; no model update.
checkpoint.contract_check_ref: Fixed source model commits and 1047 previously fixed source predictions must replay exactly
checkpoint.provenance_verdict: Frozen designated Phase1 source contract; previous Phase1 development results observed, no clean-blind claim
checkpoint.selection_rule: No selection, labels, fitting or target inference in extraction; save numeric source features for preregistered follow-up

execution.launch_owner: Codex source candidate reliability feature owner
execution.gpu_policy: GPU0 single owner; source-only fixed inference; real source replay smoke

metrics_plan.prediction_ref: Three fixed source L_s prediction artifacts
metrics_plan.scientific_rule: No labels during feature extraction; only previous fixed source predictions and IQ. Features include confidence, normalized entropy, cosine similarity, agreement and waveform distances.
